threads.body: These `metrics` blocks turn measurement-only scenarios into exact metric-name assertions, contrary to `scenarios/gen-ai/README.md:174–183`. Missing or renamed metrics then fail the scenario instead of remaining measured instrumentation gaps. Remove all three blocks (also lines 26–28 and 32–35); the runner collects emitted metrics and registry findings without them.

threads.body: The streaming contract requires every supported sampling option (`scenarios/gen-ai/README.md:71–76`), but this request only sets max tokens and temperature. Omitting the other options exercised by `python/openai/scenarios/streaming.py` makes missing request-attribute coverage reflect the scenario rather than the instrumentation. Set the supported options to the sibling values and regenerate `data.json`; OpenAI's unsupported top-k can remain omitted.

+"""Conformance scenario: a streamed Pydantic AI agent run.
